decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.
Condition : 4 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 1,Clunbury Avenue, Heston

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the western flank wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - 6.	 Before the development commences details of the widening of the vehicular crossover to the curtilage of the property shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the crossover shown on the approved drawing shall be available for use before first occupation of any part of the development.
description: Erection of part 2 storey side and part first floor rear extension, erection of a hipped roof to the existing and proposed two storey flank extension and conversion of garage to habitable room
